title: Lock graph-native node semantics around source/selection/type/domain/param/build defaults
description: Settle the immediate authored-node semantics so the runtime, tests, and saved graph draft all match the same mental model.
acceptance_criteria: The build-centered model is written down and tested for broad defaults, grouped overrides, stronger excludes, and default inheritance behavior.

title: Align saved graph format and runtime compiler around build-centered branches
description: Make the saved graph shape and the runtime node compiler describe the same authored branch structure instead of drifting separately.
acceptance_criteria: The saved graph draft and the runtime compiler agree on the explicit node types, allowed branch patterns, and build-resolution behavior.

title: Finalize graph-native guide build semantics and saved shape
description: Finish the build-centered graph-native guide model around authored branches feeding a build, with defaults staying implicit and exclude remaining stronger than inclusion within a build.
design: Treat the node model as source, optional selection, explicit type, optional domain and param overrides, then build. Keep human text guide work lower priority until this shape is more settled.

title: Apply structured configs to startup and runtime callsites
description: Replace the highest-value dynamic cfg.get(...) access patterns in startup, optimizer setup, and runtime paths with the new structured config objects.
acceptance_criteria: Core startup and optimizer/runtime callsites use structured config access for the newly typed areas, with validation and templates kept in sync.

title: Define structured config schemas for root, optimizer, recipe, and scorer settings
description: Add dataclass-backed structured configs for the stable runtime areas that are already semantically settled.
acceptance_criteria: Hydra startup has typed schemas for the stable runtime config surface; templates and code agree on the field names and nesting for those areas.

title: Adopt structured Hydra configs for stable runtime settings
description: Introduce structured Hydra config dataclasses for the stable runtime surface so the config/code contract is more explicit and less dependent on ad hoc cfg.get(...) access.
design: First pass should cover stable settings only: root runtime settings, optimizer settings, recipe optimization settings, and scorer/runtime transport settings. Leave the optimization guide out of this pass while the graph-native guide model is still evolving.

title: Revisit bounds.py after graph-native guide semantics settle
description: Resume the deferred bounds cleanup after the graph-native guide shape is stable enough that bounds no longer has to preserve ambiguous legacy guide semantics as the design center.
acceptance_criteria: There is a concrete follow-up plan for bounds cleanup that assumes the finalized graph-native guide semantics rather than the old strategy surface.

title: Write migration guide from legacy guide to graph-native guide
description: Explain how current strategy-style guides map into the graph-native model and how the same intent will appear in node-based authoring later.
acceptance_criteria: There is a practical migration note covering old concepts, new concepts, worked examples, and what remains intentionally legacy for now.
